thought
Whoa! Why is the user replying "I don't know" to almost everything? Let's check what they answered on Q3:
Q3: "Which company do you work for, and what is your main job with the drones?" -> They gave a detailed answer!
Why did Q1, Q2, Q4, Q5, Q6, Q7 get "I don't know"?
Wait—let's check the required topics carefully, one simple question at a time (notice Q5, Q6, Q7 all had "and" / two parts? No, Q3 ALSO had two parts! Wait: Q1, Q2, Q4, Q7 were about past experience / daily schedule / worst day, which maybe the prompt of the interviewee explicitly tells them they don't know if it's not in their spec!).
Wait: "Nobody has designed the service yet... You will not see any other description of their work: what you learn, you learn from them."
Let's test asking about taking a drone out of service for repairs and putting it back, or sending drones to charge! Let's ask a single, direct question about one of the tasks they listed in Q3!When you take a drone out of service for repairs, what needs to happen so nobody tries to use it?
